Description
The University of Reading is one of the UK’s leading research intensive universities and is ranked in the top 200 universities in the world by QS. The university has a global outlook, with 17,000 current students from 150 countries. The university has a student satisfaction rate of 89% and has a top 10-ranked Student’s Union, which runs 150 clubs and societies.
The National Research Excellence Framework 2014 classed 78% of the university's research as internationally excellent making Reading 19th in the UK for research intensity and 27th for research power.
